_note: Clause categories LeaseLens looks for. Add a new object to support a new category; add matching rules in risk_rules.json and guidance in guidance.json.

categories.label: Automatic renewal
categories.description: The agreement continues for a new term unless someone cancels in time.

categories.label: Security deposit and deductions
categories.description: Money held up front and the rules for keeping or deducting from it.

categories.label: Hidden or additional fees
categories.description: Charges on top of the main rent, salary deduction, or loan payment.

categories.label: Termination and notice
categories.description: How and when either side can end the agreement, and what it costs.

categories.label: Penalties and late charges
categories.description: Charges for paying late, breaking a rule, or leaving early.

categories.label: Liability and indemnification
categories.description: Who pays when something goes wrong, including covering the other side's losses.

categories.label: One-sided changes to terms
categories.description: One party can change prices or terms without the other party agreeing.

categories.label: Restrictions on your rights
categories.description: Limits on what you can do, waivers of rights, or access to your home or property.

categories.label: Unclear or contradictory language
categories.description: Vague, open-ended or conflicting wording that could be read in more than one way.

categories.label: Non-compete and non-solicitation
categories.description: Limits on where you can work or whom you can contact after the agreement ends.

categories.label: Interest and repayment terms
categories.description: How interest is charged, changed, and what happens with early or missed payments.

categories.label: Disputes and governing law
categories.description: Where and how disagreements are decided, such as arbitration or a specific court.
